{{Quote|Master Windu! Master Windu!''"<br />"''Veda! Get back here immediately!''"<br />"''But I want to ask him something!"|Veda and her instructor|<ref name="BFP" />}}
An '''individual''' served as an instructor for [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="BFP" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] met the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in a corridor at the temple and showed him his quarters. Shortly after meeting Fett, a youngling of her group called [[Veda (Youngling)|Veda]] recognized [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] passing by and went to him to ask the senior [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] a "very important question," much to the distress of her instructor.<ref name="BFP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The instructor appeared in ''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]'', a young readers' novel written by [[Elizabeth Hand]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="BFP" />
